The differences between Zener breakdown and Avalanche breakdown are summarized below:

| Feature | Zener Breakdown | Avalanche Breakdown |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Mechanism** | High electric field pulls valence electrons directly into the conduction band (tunneling). | Carrier multiplication due to impact ionization by thermally generated carriers. |
| **Doping Concentration** | Heavily doped P-N junctions (narrow depletion region). | Lightly or moderately doped P-N junctions (wider depletion region). |
| **Breakdown Voltage ($V_z$)** | Low ($< 5	ext{ V}$). | High ($> 6	ext{ V}$). |
| **Temperature Coefficient** | Negative (voltage decreases as temperature increases). | Positive (voltage increases as temperature increases). |
